title: Format phone numbers
description: The customers table has been pre-loaded with 8 customer records (IDs 1-8). Add a phone_number column, then set phone numbers: customer 5 gets '1234567890', customer 6 gets '123-456-7890', customer 7 gets '(987)654-3210', customer 8 gets '9876543210'.
hints: ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN phone_number VARCHAR(20)
Use UPDATE with CASE based on customer_id
Phone numbers are intentionally stored in different formats
